Subject: MSA redline + portal onboarding evidence request

Hi Chloe,

Thanks for the demo last week. We're ready to move forward but legal asked us to walk through a few MSA redline items before we finish portal registration. Were also documenting the procurement portal requirements so our AP team can accept POs automatically.

Quick summary of asks from our side: 
- Can you review the attached MSA with inline redlines and confirm whether Redwood can accept the liability cap language we proposed (see §9)?
- Order Form: we need a billing address update and a CLIN for professional services on the OF (attached).
- Portal: we use Ariba (supplier zone). AP expects a PO ack within 24h and sends invoices via the Ariba Network (EDI). Please confirm you support 850/855/810 mapping and whether Redwood will map invoice lines to item-level quantities.
- Evidence: SOC2 report (most recent), KYC (W9 / tax id), proof of cyber insurance. Can you provide an evidence bundle or a link?

Wed like to schedule a 30-min sync with Chloe + legal and our procurement ops to align on the mutual action plan. Are you available Thurs 8/6 10:00-10:30 PT or Fri 8/7 14:00-14:30 PT?

Attachments: MSA_redline_v1.docx, OrderForm_Starlite_v1.xlsx

Thanks,
Samantha Green
Sr. Procurement Manager
Starlite Health

Procurement Ops Team <procurement-ops@starlitehealth.com>

- Ariba: we support EDI/Ariba Network for PO & invoices (850/855/810). Kimberly: can you confirm whether we produce item-level invoice lines or consolidated invoice per order?
- Evidence: we can share SOC2 type II (2025) and a standard evidence bundle; Ill attach a link in the follow-up.
- Liability cap & data clauses: Markus will advise on the redline timeline; expect a 1-2 business day turnaround on comments.

Proposed mutual action plan (high level):
1) Legal redline review: Markus to provide line-item comments and a short summary (target 8/5 EOD).
2) Ops field map: Kimberly to confirm Ariba field mapping and PO ack SLA (target 8/6 EOD).
3) Evidence delivery: Chloe to send SOC2 + KYC by 8/6 morning.
4) Sync: 30-min call to close open items and confirm sign path (DocuSign) — proposed Thu 8/6 10:00 PT (works for us).

Kimberly, can you confirm the EDI mapping and whether we need any PO metadata (cost center, project code) to be present for Starlite?

Ive attached the Redwood vendor pack (attachment stub in this thread).

Best,

Chloe, thanks for the quick response — Thu 8/6 10:00 PT works for our team. A couple clarifications from procurement ops: 
- We will send POs from Ariba with the PO number in the "BuyerPO" field and expect an 855 acknowledgment. If Redwoods system requires a specific "PO Type" or "BuyerDepartment" field, please confirm and we can ask our buyers to populate it.
- For invoices: AP favors item-level detail when the PO includes multiple line items; single-line consolidated invoices are acceptable for one-off services.
- Signature: we prefer DocuSign for the OF signature; can Redwood initiate?

Also, legal had an ask on data residency for PHI data — can you confirm whether customer data will be processed in US regions only? If not, we need language around EU transfer safeguards.

Well attach a short data processing addendum if needed.

Thanks — see you on Thu.
Samantha

On Tue, Aug 4, 2026 at 10:03 AM Chloe Martin <chloe.martin@redwood.com> wrote:
> Chloe: thanks for the clear list. Looping in Markus (legal) and Kimberly (ops) so we can cover redlines...

Hi Samantha / Chloe — I reviewed the redline and attach a short summary (Legal_summary_MSA_comments.pdf) with line references to the doc you sent. High-level:

1) Liability cap: we can accept a reciprocal cap but need clearer language on consequential damages carve-outs. Propose: keep a mutual cap at 3x fees with mutual carve-out wording (see summary, comment 4).
2) Data residency / PHI: Redwoods hosted deployments for Starlite can be constrained to US-only regions under our Private deployment offering; for Hosted, we provide contractual guarantees w/appropriate SCCs and encryption-at-rest, but if Starlite requires on-prem or VPC-only, that will need a Private plan addendum.
3) Audit & access: limit audit frequency to once per 12 months with reasonable scope; no live system access without a signed NDA and audit plan.

Kimberly: please confirm the Ariba mapping items Chloe flagged (PO ack SLA, BuyerPO field mapping) and whether ops needs a fallback plan (email PO + PDF) if EDI mapping fails during activation.

I can take the MSA redline offline after the call and prepare a clean tracked copy for DocuSign by 8/9 if were aligned on the above.

Regards,
Markus Klein
Senior Counsel — Contracts & Privacy
Redwood Inference
(attachment: Legal_summary_MSA_comments.pdf)
